title: Lazy raw DXF section projection copy
scope: Avoid copying the full retained raw-section collection before knowing whether the AcDs DXF projection will append a generated section.
Keep source raw sections immutable and preserve existing AcDs validation and writer replay behavior.

sourceChange.before: fileExport copied dx_data::rawDxfSections into a local mutable vector for every export. The helper only appended at its final step, and the writer setter copied the completed vector again.
sourceChange.after: The helper reads source sections by const reference, reports whether it generated an append, and makes an isolated copy only after all existing graph/schema checks pass. No-append exports pass source sections to the writer's const-reference setter; append exports move the augmented working copy into the writer.
sourceChange.effect: Removes one complete raw-section clone from the common no-append path and one writer-handoff copy from the append path. Source collections remain unchanged. Allocation failure during projection is converted to a clean preflight refusal.

focusedTests.coverage: Generated AC1027 multi-record AcDs projection in ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.diffCheck: scoped git diff --check passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Avoids a redundant deep copy of the retained raw-section collection on exports that do not generate an AcDs section, while preserving the copy-before-append model for qualified AcDs projection.

testsRun: Strict dwg2dxf, fixture-test, adapter-test, and local-roundtrip targets
Focused raw-section capture and passthrough controls
Focused generated AC1027 multi-record AcDs projection in ASCII/Binary DXF
Focused owner, linetype, class, dictionary, and writer regressions
method.limitations: No RSS or allocator instrumentation was run. The no-append path still copies raw sections once into codec ownership; AcDs projection still requires an isolated full source copy. No semantic-support or whole-process memory-bound claim is made.
